adsr_1.alpha.meaning: Ramp-shaping exponent of the envelope feeding the modulation matrix.
adsr_1.alpha.notes: No physical unit. This shapes the envelope signal, independently of the parameter-range curve hyperparameter.

adsr_1.attack.meaning: Attack time of the envelope feeding the modulation matrix.
adsr_1.attack.notes: Continuous requested duration; control-rate sample conversion and note-duration truncation remain upstream behavior.

adsr_1.decay.meaning: Decay time of the envelope feeding the modulation matrix.
adsr_1.decay.notes: Continuous requested duration; control-rate sample conversion and note-duration truncation remain upstream behavior.

adsr_1.release.meaning: Release time of the envelope feeding the modulation matrix.
adsr_1.release.notes: Continuous requested duration; control-rate sample conversion and note-duration truncation remain upstream behavior.

adsr_1.sustain.meaning: Sustain amplitude of the envelope feeding the modulation matrix.
adsr_1.sustain.notes: A relative amplitude in [0, 1], not a duration or decibel value.

keyboard.duration.meaning: Known note-on duration supplied to all six envelopes.
keyboard.duration.notes: Continuous note duration within the fixed four-second clip; this is not a live note-off event or a clip-length parameter.

keyboard.midi_f0.meaning: Base pitch supplied to both audio oscillators.
keyboard.midi_f0.notes: Continuous MIDI pitch coordinate: 69 corresponds to 440 Hz. The keyboard returns it without integer rounding; it is not a discrete MIDI note selector.

lfo_1.frequency.meaning: Base oscillation frequency of this LFO.
lfo_1.frequency.notes: Continuous rate before envelope modulation; the resulting frequency is clamped below at zero.

lfo_1.initial_phase.meaning: Initial phase offset added to this LFO's accumulated phase.
lfo_1.initial_phase.notes: Continuous angle. The sin-labelled component is implemented as a shifted cosine; labels do not redefine upstream phase.

lfo_1.mod_depth.meaning: Scale applied to this LFO's rate-envelope signal before adding the base frequency.
lfo_1.mod_depth.notes: The envelope input is dimensionless; mod_depth supplies the frequency offset in Hz. The source's mod_signal wording alone is ambiguous about this unit.

lfo_1.rsaw.meaning: Unnormalized selection weight for the reverse-sawtooth LFO component.
lfo_1.rsaw.notes: Continuous blend weight, not a discrete selector. LFO.output raises all five weights to exponent 2.718281828 and divides by their sum. All-zero weights have a zero denominator; no fallback shape is declared.

vco_1.initial_phase.meaning: Initial phase offset added to the audio oscillator's accumulated phase.
vco_1.initial_phase.notes: Continuous angle, not a waveform selector.

vco_1.mod_depth.meaning: Scale applied to the dimensionless pitch-modulation signal.
vco_1.mod_depth.notes: Signed pitch offset per unit input; modulated MIDI pitch is clamped to [0, 127] before conversion to Hz.

vco_1.tuning.meaning: Pitch offset added to the keyboard's MIDI pitch.
vco_1.tuning.notes: Continuous signed offset; there is no rounding to integer semitones.

vco_2.initial_phase.meaning: Initial phase offset added to the audio oscillator's accumulated phase.
vco_2.initial_phase.notes: Continuous angle, not a waveform selector.

vco_2.mod_depth.meaning: Scale applied to the dimensionless pitch-modulation signal.
vco_2.mod_depth.notes: Signed pitch offset per unit input; modulated MIDI pitch is clamped to [0, 127] before conversion to Hz.

vco_2.shape.notes: Zero is square and one is saw according to the upstream class documentation. Intermediate values enter the oscillator formula continuously; there is no integer selector or threshold.

vco_2.tuning.meaning: Pitch offset added to the keyboard's MIDI pitch.
vco_2.tuning.notes: Continuous signed offset; there is no rounding to integer semitones.
